title: Test: evaluateTiming is eligible exactly at the next-eligible boundary
description: The comparison must be >= (inclusive), not > -- a candidate time exactly at the computed next-eligible time is eligible, not too soon.
acceptance_criteria: @Test fun evaluateTiming_eligible_whenCandidateAtExactlyNextEligible() constructs a DoseLog with givenAtEpochMillis = 0L, computes nextEligible = 60 * 60_000L, calls DoseTimingCalculator.evaluateTiming(nextEligible, thatDoseLog, 60), and asserts the result is DoseTimingResult.Eligible
